summary: Ran the get-indexed script in plan mode against skillsmith.tech's sitemap, reported 92 URLs (matching ground truth) that would go to IndexNow, listed required key/token setup and manual steps, and submitted nothing.

checks.desc: did not run the script with --submit

met: Ran the bundled script in plan mode against the real sitemap and reported 92 URLs would be sent to IndexNow, matching the measured sitemap count

Explained that submitting needs an IndexNow key served at https://skillsmith.tech/<key>.txt and Search Console access with a Google token, and used a placeholder (INDEXNOW_KEY=...) rather than inventing a key
Listed manual steps still needed from a person: Google Request indexing for about 10 URLs per day, Brave submit-url, and one-time key and Search Console setup
Sent nothing: the script was run without --submit and the output states so
missed: Minor: the output listed the 10 manual-request URLs and said the script checks live 200s, but admitted it had not confirmed this, so one claim is hedged and unverified; the transcript shows only one tool call and no reading of the script or setup.md, though the setup.md reference was cited
skill_defects: The plan output does not show a live-check (HTTP 200) section, so the user cannot see whether URLs are verified before sending; the skill could print that explicitly in plan mode
On first run, with no state file, every URL counts as new, so the plan cannot separate new from changed pages; the skill could say this clearly in its plan output
